versions.caption: The foundation: local library, metadata, ratings, backups and the original browser.
Privacy and personal state: Incognito, app lock, read tracking and filters.
The native-browser era brought feeds, sorting, comments and the gallery slideshow.
Desktop Bridge introduced encrypted local-network library control.
Subscriptions, notifications and background checks expanded the library.
Responsiveness, duplicate checks and backup-backed thumbnail reuse were polished.
Heatmaps, saved layouts, downloads and offline reading defined this era.
The Android rewrite consolidated backup, downloads and library tooling.
Suggestions and privacy became deeper, first-class systems.
The modern dashboard and refined reader surfaces arrived.
Reading Trends, training, Tag Presets, Library Health and Verified Restore.
Multi-source profiles, social QR sharing and a first-class Desktop Bridge.
